beliefs: f strips leading and trailing spaces and tabs from the input [E3, E4, E5, E6]
Empty stripped result yields 'i' [E1, E3, E5]
Internal whitespace is preserved; only leading/trailing whitespace is stripped [E4]
For strings with no leading whitespace, insertion index is len(stripped)//2 (floor) [E1, E2, E7, E8]
For strings with no leading whitespace but trailing whitespace, index is (len(stripped)+1)//2 rounded up [E3, E6, E17]
For leading-whitespace strings, index = abs(orig_len//2 - lead_ws), clamped to [0, len(stripped)] [E14, E15, E16, E18, E19, E20]
E21 confirms the abs(orig_len//2 - lead_ws) formula for leading-whitespace strings, including ' ab'->'iab' (index 0) and '   ab'->'i ab' (index 1) [E21]

E22 shows the leading-whitespace index formula also holds for tab-prefixed strings: '\tx'->'ix', '\t\tx'->'i\tx', '\t\t\tx'->'i\tx', '\t\t\t\tx'->'i\t\tx', ' \tx'->'i\tx', '\t x'->'i x', ' \t x'->'i x', '\t \tx'->'i\tx', '  \tx'->'i\tx', '\t\t x'->'i x' [E22]
E5/E6/E12/E16 mismatches are due to the model's handling of trailing whitespace combined with leading whitespace and tab-only strings, not the leading-whitespace index formula [E5, E6, E12, E16]?
notes: E22 matches abs(orig_len//2 - lead_ws) exactly for tab-prefixed strings, so the leading-whitespace formula is confirmed; the remaining mismatches (E5/E6/E12/E16) are about trailing-whitespace interaction, which I still can't fully explain. I kept the formula and flagged the unresolved part.
